approval_class: MIXED - contains a DESTRUCTIVE element (pausing six existing ads)

blocker_that_forced_this.meaning: Google Ads allows at most 3 ENABLED responsive search ads per ad group. Paused RSAs do not count: each of the three ad groups reports existing_count=2 while holding 4 non-removed RSAs (2 ENABLED originals + 2 PAUSED replacements). Enabling both replacements would make 4 enabled, which exceeds the limit.
validated_facts: Enabling all six at once: REJECTED, 3 errors (operations 1, 3, 5 - the second ad in each group).
Enabling ONE replacement per ad group: VALIDATES OK.
Pausing the 6 originals and enabling the 6 replacements in one atomic request: VALIDATES OK.
blocker_that_forced_this.why_the_original_sequence_was_wrong: The enablement package 80868F985D33B756 assumed the replacements could be enabled first and the originals paused later, to guarantee no service interruption. The 3-enabled-RSA limit makes that impossible for 2 new + 2 old. The premise was also unnecessary: the six originals are DISAPPROVED and therefore cannot serve, so pausing them causes NO service interruption at all.

action: ONE atomic MutateAdGroupAds request, partial_failure=false, 12 operations, each with an explicit ["status"] update mask: pause the 6 DISAPPROVED originals, then enable the 6 APPROVED replacements. No other field on any resource is touched.

achieves_intended_end_state: YES - exactly two eligible, service-specific RSAs per active ad group, reached in a single atomic step with no window in which an ad group has zero eligible ads.
validation_evidence: validate_only=true on this exact 12-operation request: VALIDATES OK.
explicitly_not_included: Removing any ad - the six originals are PAUSED, not removed, and stay fully recoverable.
Editing any headline, description, URL, path or pin.
Any change to campaigns, budgets, schedules, keywords, negatives, conversions, assets, sitelinks, landing pages, phone numbers, bidding, or manager access.
readback_procedure: 1. ASSERT the six replacements are ENABLED and still APPROVED with zero policy topics.
2. ASSERT the six originals are PAUSED and still DISAPPROVED - paused, never removed.
3. ASSERT each of the three ad groups has exactly 2 ENABLED RSAs and 2 PAUSED RSAs.
4. ASSERT every headline, description, final URL, path and pin on the six replacements is byte-identical to fingerprint 0BCC73A397580856.
5. ASSERT total non-removed ads is still 113 - nothing created, nothing removed.
6. ASSERT the five campaigns are still ENABLED / SERVING / TARGET_SPEND with unchanged budgets ($141.45 / $42.76 / $138.16 / $78.95 / $26.32).
7. ASSERT unchanged counts: campaign criteria 13810, keywords 6968, conversion actions 23, shared sets 17, shared criteria 7015, campaign assets 271, ad-schedule criteria 139.
8. ASSERT both manager links ACTIVE and unchanged, including ClickCease 2815082755.
9. Read-only delivery check: campaign and ad-group serving status, and impressions over the next 48 hours in Gas Boiler Repair and HVAC Replacement.

rollback_plan.method: One atomic request reversing all 12 statuses: enable the 6 originals, pause the 6 replacements.
rollback_plan.data_loss: None. Status changes delete nothing and preserve all history.
rollback_plan.note: Rolling back restores 2 DISAPPROVED enabled ads per ad group, i.e. zero eligible ads again. Roll back only if the replacements themselves misbehave.
rollback_plan.trigger: Any readback assertion fails, or a replacement is disapproved after enabling.

partial_write_protocol: partial_failure=false makes the batch atomic. If it fails, STOP, re-query all 12 statuses, inventory exactly what changed, and produce a recovery plan before any retry.
risk_note: Enabling starts real spend in two campaigns that have never served. Conversion tracking is still incomplete: the Gravity Forms fields capture no click IDs, so form leads will not be attributable until the landing-page fix lands. Budgets are unchanged and Maximize Clicks caps daily spend.
